title: RWB-P1-E1001-APP: schema-split mechanics, login name, extension-table delivery boundary and Arch v5 against FSD and TSD P1
source: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 15, 29, 41 and 45; TSD P1 v3 T3.1 to T3.6; FSD P1 v3 A2.1 and A2.2; Ownership Map part tables; Template and Rules v1 R6
description: Four points are open for this story. (1) The built migration V0001__rwb_e1_001_recovery_schema.sql in schema recovery is kept as built and is not rewritten, so P1's 18 tables need a new per-service Flyway file on rwb-source-data's own sequence; which sequence number, and whether the split migration or a separate DB story creates P1's own tables, is not stated, and the split plan holds no RWB-P1-E1001-DB story. (2) Schema and login are named rwb_source_data on slide 29 and slide 41, but no source states the rule for a login whose service short name contains a hyphen. (3) The four extension tables are P1's data and are delivered by RWB-P1-E1069-DB, while their 49 dictionary fields must exist before the tables do, so the conformance test cannot report 1,062 of 1,062 fields until RWB-P1-E1069-DB has run. (4) Arch v5 slide 15 gives P1 the REST contract of /customers, /accounts, /collateral, /payments, /freshness and /business-days/{date}/ready, while FSD P1 v3, TSD P1 v3 and the API Specification also give P1 the data product, dictionary and data contract operations, and Arch v5 slide 41 lists P1 as owning the ACE view contract, the extension tables, freshness and reconciliation only, not the catalog and the dictionary tables.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 15 rwb-source-data IN and OUT lines; slide 29 schema and login panel; slide 41 P1 row; slide 45 'Who reads ACE data'; TSD P1 v3 T3.2 two-migration rule and T3.5 extension tables; FSD P1 v3 A2.1 and A2.2; Ownership Map part tables (data_product, sys_objects, sys_fields, data_contract owned by P1); split_plan.json holds no RWB-P1-E1001-DB
proposed: Adopt the five assumptions below for wave 1: keep the built baseline as built; create P1's 13 own tables in rwb_source_data from this story's split migration; name schema and login rwb_source_data; leave the four extension tables to RWB-P1-E1069-DB while this story seeds their 49 dictionary fields; keep the catalog, the dictionary tables and the v_data_dictionary read model in rwb_source_data with no REST operation added by this story; and confirm in the verification loop that the catalog, dictionary and data-contract operations of the P1 contract stay with RWB-P1-E1064-APP, RWB-P1-E1015-APP and RWB-P1-E1016-APP
